source_quote: After i.v. administration to rats, OT was rapidly cleared from systemic circulation with a plasma clearance and steady-state volume of distribution of 17.1 ml/min/kg and 0.085 liters/kg, respectively, resulting in a short half-life of 0.12 hour.
